source_text: 🈚: I think question mode may be "done for now" but I certainly don't think it is done-done.
reply_text:
🈚 is fair. Checking what zai-1's "parked" work actually is before saying more.🈹 ("I certainly don't think it is done-done") You're right, and "I finished question mode" overstated it. The search mode itself exists and is tested (futon7 `aacf83e`), and its first real briefs came back with your verdicts. That is the "done for now" part. What a question brief is for is still open, and recorded in futon7:
- **The question-question** (`INDEX-questions-and-breakdowns.md`, "Open"). A brief doesn't carry the id of the apex question it serves; you only knew Q-mozilla-9 from its title. Mojira doesn't show the question or its ⿱ row above the items. A "worth" verdict isn't written back to the question as a candidate citation. Until those exist, triage doesn't feed the argument graph.
- **The burn-in** (`E-daily-loop-burn-in.md`):
  - twenty weekdays of briefs with your triage;
  - the day-20 evaluation: did it lead to a consulting conversation, and do the predictions beat the base rate;
  - a warning when briefs stop for more than two weekdays.
- **Coverage.** Question briefs are generated only for the library-kind questions. The experiment, trial and ruling kinds have no brief form yet.

㊟ (zai-1's "parked" work) futon7 has no modified files and no worktree. The only trace is the uncommitted `retrieval-results.json` (11-10), which is the output of `questions_retrieve.py` and is listed in the index as "not committed". zai-1's unfinished changes either never reached the shared checkout or were lost with an earlier job, so there is nothing to resume as it stands.

㊭ (next, when you want it) The question-question is the natural next step, one small packet:
1. A question brief carries `:brief/question-id`.
2. Mojira shows the question and its ⿱ row above the items.
3. A "worth" verdict is written back as a candidate citation on that question.

zai-1 asked to continue question-mode work, so it could take this. Shall I send it now, or hold it until the pattern-index and 狗 packets have landed?
